description: Build the futuristic single-page frontend and the voice agent (all inside webapp/static/, no build step, no npm, no CDN - must work offline on the laptop), plus the documentation deliverables: webapp/README.md (run + later A100 hosting instructions), docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md (the layer description page), the appended CHANGELOG.md entry required by AGENTS.md rule 8, and the git commit of exactly the new paths on feat/webapp-voice-console.
steps: webapp/static/index.html + style.css + app.js: dark sci-fi HUD (near-black background #05070d, neon cyan #35f0ff primary, amber accents, monospace/terminal typography, subtle scanline/grid overlay via CSS gradients - no image assets, no external fonts so it works offline). Layout: left = live camera panel (the WS 'frame' messages drawn into an via data URL, with camera name + fps readout); centre = chat console styled like Claude Code in a web (user task input, streamed transcript: user lines, assistant text, collapsible tool_use blocks showing name+input JSON, tool_result blocks, inline camera thumbnails from 'image' events, status line while the agent is working, CANCEL button while active); right = telemetry column (8 joint bars 0..1 with current_ma/temp from 'state' messages, e-stop latch indicator, backend + model badges, human-gate countdown in station mode).

E-STOP: a large red button, always visible, fixed position; onclick sends BOTH {'type':'estop'} over the WS and POST /api/estop (belt and braces); after e-stop the UI latches a red banner until a RELEASE button (POST /api/release) clears it. E-stop must work even while the agent is mid-task.

Station-mode human gate UX: when /api/status reports backend==station and human_confirmed==false, show a modal 'HUMAN AT THE TABLE?' - the chat input and any motion are blocked until the user confirms (POST /api/confirm-human); the confirmation countdown (human_window_s) is shown in the header and the modal reappears on expiry. In sim mode show a subtle 'SIMULATION' badge instead. Never hide which backend is driving the robot.

Voice agent (zero GPU, v1): a mic toggle button using the browser Web Speech API (window.SpeechRecognition || webkitSpeechRecognition) - final transcripts are inserted into the chat input and auto-sent as chat messages; interim results shown live in the input. Spoken replies via window.speechSynthesis (speak the assistant 'final' texts and short tool summaries like 'picking cell C4' when voice is enabled; a speaker toggle mutes). If the browser lacks these APIs show a small greyed-out 'voice needs Chrome/Edge' hint - the app must fully work without voice. Do NOT send audio anywhere; no other speech model is introduced.

Chat behaviour: Enter sends {'type':'chat','text'} on the WS; render streamed events as they arrive; while agent_active disable the send button and show CANCEL (sends {'type':'cancel'}); on {'type':'error'} show the message inline (e.g. missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Suggested-task chips above the input: 'put the red block in the blue tray', 'look around', 'go home' (click fills the input).

WebSocket client: connect to ws://<host>/ws, auto-reconnect with backoff (1s,2s,4s... max 10s) and a connection badge (green/amber/red); on reload resume cleanly. All rendering vanilla JS + a little Canvas for the joint bars; total JS < ~600 lines, no dependencies.

webapp/README.md: (1) what it is - the web/voice layer over normakit, 'Claude Code in a web' for the ElRobot arm, sim by default; (2) run: .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend sim --port 8920 -> http://127.0.0.1:8920 ; real arm: ./norma start first, then --backend station --i-have-a-human (document the human-at-table rule, the one-writer rule = close the Station web UI control panel at :8889, e-stop = servo power plug); (3) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env, never in files; model override NORMA_MODEL; (4) voice: browser Web Speech API, no GPU, Chrome/Edge; (5) HOSTING LATER on the A100: run the same command with --host 0.0.0.0 behind an SSH tunnel or TLS proxy (mirror server/README.md's guidance), optional GPU upgrade path for voice = host Whisper (STT) + Piper/Coqui (TTS) on the A100 later behind env-var-configured URLs (e.g. WEBAPP_STT_URL/WEBAPP_TTS_URL placeholders - NOT implemented in v1, no invented hosts/credentials); (6) demo script for the hackathon: exact steps + the sim demo task 'put the red block in the blue tray'; (7) tests: .venv/bin/python -m pytest webapp/tests -q (no hardware/key); (8) explicit note: Claude API is the only model used by this layer and no fine-tuning path is introduced anywhere; (9) changelog for this layer is here in the README + repo CHANGELOG.md entry.

docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md (docs numbering 01..12 exists; 13 is next): one page describing the layer - architecture (browser <-> WS/HTTP <-> FastAPI webapp/ <-> normakit Arm/Guard <-> sim|station), the Claude tool-use loop reuse from normakit.agent, the safety chain (Guard untouched, --i-have-a-human, 10-min human gate, e-stop, one writer), the voice approach + A100 upgrade path, what is NOT changed (every existing folder/file untouched), test story, and honest limits (voice = browser APIs, sim physics is logic-level, station mode untested on live hardware by this layer).

CHANGELOG.md: append ONE bullet at the top of the '### Added' list under '## [Unreleased] - 2026-11-22' (the file's newest-first convention), e.g.: '- `webapp/`: futuristic web console + voice agent over normakit (FastAPI :8920, WebSocket telemetry/camera, Claude tool-use chat reusing `normakit.agent`, browser STT/TTS, sim default; station mode needs `--i-have-a-human` + 10-min human-presence confirm; e-stop via Guard; no existing file touched) + `docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md`. Sim tested, real arm not run - Claude' (match the terse factual style of the existing entries, keep the ' - Claude' suffix as the file does). This is the ONLY permitted edit to an existing file; make it an append at the top of that section, changing nothing else in the file.

Screenshot for the demo: capture one real camera frame through the running app into webapp/static/ is NOT required; instead verify the frame event renders (the frontend draws the live WS frames - that is the demo). If a headless screenshot tool exists on the laptop it is optional; do not install anything.

Final checks then commit: .venv/bin/python -m pytest webapp/tests -q && .venv/bin/python scripts/selftest_sim.py both green; boot the server in sim and curl / (200) and /api/status; then git add webapp docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md CHANGELOG.md (exactly these paths - NEVER git add -A or git add .; .agents/ stays untracked) and git commit with a plain descriptive message like 'Web console and voice agent layer over normakit (webapp/, sim-tested, docs 13)' - NO Claude/AI attribution in the commit message (team rule in docs/NEXT_AGENT_PROMPT.md), no push.
